messages:
noah: Heads up — US-WEST canary showing ~5% 5xx spike, p95 up ~120ms.

deploy-bot: Canary monitor: p95>100ms threshold breached, alerts sent to #eng-oncall. Auto-rollback rule NOT triggered: 'requests/sec' gating condition unmet.

kevin: Did deploy-bot use the right error-rate threshold? I thought rulepack includes >3% 5xx for rollback.

deploy-bot: Active rulepack release/2026-04-03 -> error_rate_threshold=4%. Threshold mismatch with runbook. Manual rollback recommended.

lina: Traces point at new kvcache-hotfix kernel path. Regression in quantized attention path on a subset of models.

noah: @ops_lead can you approve a manual rollback to v2.4.1 for us-west? We should avoid cascading customer impact.

ops_lead: Approved. Run pre-rollback checklist: incident created, support notified, pause any new canaries targeting us-west, ensure runbook ready.

amber: I'll draft a short customer note once we have rollback started: "temporary degradation in US-West, rolling back to stable to restore SLA." Keep it simple.

kevin: Rolling back now. Command I'm running:
```
deploy rollback --env=prod --region=us-west-2 --to-version=2.4.1 --force
```

deploy-bot: Rollback job queued: job_id=r-20260403-71; estimated duration: config flip 2m, drain 4m. Will post progress updates.

oncall-bot: Incident created INC-2026-042-09 · severity=3 · assignee=@kevin · notes=canary-5xx-spike

kevin: Executing. Monitoring logs and telemetry; removing model pins and reverting KV cache patch.

kevin: Rollout at 25% — health checks good so far.

deploy-bot: Rollback progress: 25% -> 50%.

kevin: 50% done, a few transient 502s during drain but back to healthy.

deploy-bot: Rollback progress: 50% -> 100%.

noah: Nice. Can we add a guard so future auto-rollback considers both error_rate AND p95, not only requests/sec?

lina: I'll open an RFC to update canary rulepack defaults and add CI tests for metric gating. Also adding a regression test for the 8bit kernel path.

ops_lead: Amber, prepare the customer-facing message. Send once @kevin confirms 100% and postmortem links included.

amber: Draft ready: "We've rolled back to v2.4.1 in US-West to address elevated latency and error rates. No data loss. We're monitoring and will follow up with a postmortem." Will wait to send.

kevin: Rollback completed at 1887654780. p95 back to baseline, 5xx now 0.6%.

deploy-bot: Job r-20260403-71 complete. Telemetry shows recovery and no residual errors.

noah: Closing thread. Follow-up action items: RFC for rulepack, add CI metric gating, postmortem draft. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
